title: Denials & Appeals Response contract v1
description: Chains denial-classify -> policy-retrieve -> evidence-assemble -> deadline-track (coding decision + clock) -> appeal-draft -> deadline-track (final clock check). Citations ride this payload so provenance survives every hand-off. Action level L0 (draft-only); nothing on this contract is ever submitted by the plugin.

standards_alignment.family: X12 835/837 with CARC/RARC denial reason codes
standards: ASC X12N 835 Health Care Claim Payment/Advice (v5010)
CARC (Claim Adjustment Reason Codes) and RARC (Remittance Advice Remark Codes), X12/WPC code lists

field_map.denial.claim_value: 835 CLP03 total claim charge amount / 837 CLM02 total claim charge amount
field_map.denial.remark_codes: 835 loop 2100 MIA/MOA remark codes (claim level) or loop 2110 LQ*HE remark codes (service level) (RARC); record which segment was used
field_map.coding_request.requested_code: 837 SV101-2 / SV202-2 procedure code (CPT/HCPCS) proposed on a corrected claim
field_map.denial.original_code: 837 SV101-2 / SV202-2 procedure code as originally submitted

not_mapped.denial.denial_date: no single X12 element; the date printed on the denial letter / remittance (835: DTM*405 production date when present). When the document carries more than one candidate date and they differ, leave unset and escalate - [TO CONFIGURE: payer-specific rule for which date starts the appeal window]
not_mapped.denial.recoverable_value: derived locally, typically CLP03 minus CLP04 (charge less payment); not an X12 element
not_mapped.deadline_result.*: computed by deadline_engine from payer contract terms; outside the X12 transaction set
not_mapped.queue_ranked.*: local worklist ordering; outside the X12 transaction set
not_mapped.denial.as_of: the date the classification was performed (snapshot date); never used as 'today' for deadline arithmetic

as_of.description: Snapshot date the denial was classified. deadline_engine counts days from the real current date (or --today to reproduce a demo snapshot), never from as_of (denials-rules.md #1).

reason_code.description: CARC code or local reason label (835 CAS02).

remark_codes.description: RARC remark codes (835 MIA/MOA or LQ*HE).

recoverable_value.description: Amount still recoverable on appeal; the second ranking key (denials-rules.md #3).

queue.description: Other denials awaiting work. Input to the deterministic ranking in denials-rules.md #3.

queue_ranked.description: Engine output: queue ordered by deadline ascending then recoverable_value descending, never by ease.

deadline.description: Null when the payer has no configured appeal window; such rows sort last and are escalated, never dropped.

chart_evidence.description: Clinical evidence with its citations. supports_requested_code alone is never sufficient - denials-rules.md #2 requires a matching entry in citations[].

citations.description: Citations ride the contract so provenance survives the hand-off.

note.description: Specific source note, e.g. 'Cardiology progress note'.

supports_code.description: The procedure code this note substantiates; must equal coding_request.requested_code for a recode to be honoured.

policy_citations.description: Payer policy / contract clauses relied on, attached by policy-retrieve and carried to every later skill.

source.description: Document the clause was read from.

deadline.description: Null only on the unconfigured-payer path, where no window may be assumed (denials-rules.md #1).

days_remaining.description: Days from today (real current date, or --today) to the deadline; negative when expired. Null only on the unconfigured-payer path.

deadline_status.description: open; urgent when days_remaining <= config.urgent_threshold_days (#6); expired when days_remaining < 0 (#7); unconfigured when no window exists (#1).

coding_evidence_basis.description: The cited note and date that let a recode be honoured; null whenever no recode was honoured.

policy_basis.description: clause_id values from policy_citations carried into the engine result.

action_level.description: L0 - the engine only computes and drafts; nothing is submitted.

appeal_draft.description: Draft text only. There is no submitted state on this contract - submission happens outside the plugin.
